lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Oh no—watch out!

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: It's fine, it only got a little on me.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I'm so sorry! I was trying to carry both drinks and my bag and... I do this a lot.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You okay?

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Y-yes. Just embarrassed. Again. My sweater is all wet now too...

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Please don't look. It's clinging and I can't fix it properly here.

choices.label: Offer her your jacket so she can cover up
choices.reply: You're really kind... Thank you. I'll wash it and return it, I promise!

choices.label: Gently tell her it's fine and not to worry
choices.reply: You're not mad...? Most people get annoyed when I soak them.

choices.label: Look away politely while she adjusts
choices.reply: You're not staring... That actually helps. Thank you.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Excuse me... could you help me reach that box? I keep stretching and it still won't budge.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Thank you so much! I always feel bad asking. My arms just aren't long enough and everything is so high.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You almost had it.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Did I? My shirt keeps riding up when I try... I should really get new clothes. These never stay where they should.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Why are you looking at the floor? Did I drop something else?

choices.label: Get the box for her without comment
choices.reply: You're so reliable. I wish I could stop needing help all the time.

choices.label: Softly suggest her shirt might be the problem
choices.reply: Is it...? Oh no, is it that obvious? I thought it was fine!

choices.label: Tease her gently about how hard she was trying
choices.reply: D-don't laugh! I was really giving it my all...

openingByFlag.luna_jacket: You lent me your jacket last time. I still have it... clean, I promise. Could you help me with this shelf?
openingByFlag.luna_calm: You were so calm when I spilled everything. Maybe you can help me with something that doesn't involve liquids?
openingByFlag.luna_lookaway: You looked away when my sweater got wet. That was really considerate. Could you help me reach this?

events.title: The Stretch That Broke the Silence

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Almost... just a little more...

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Luna, your shirt—

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Hmm? Did it ride up again? I felt a breeze. Hold on, I'll fix it.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Maybe I should just get it for you.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: You're staring at the wall really hard. Did I do something weird again?

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: People do that a lot around me. I never know why. Is my hair messy?

choices.label: Just get the item and change the subject
choices.reply: You're the best. I don't know what I'd do without people like you.

choices.label: Gently explain that her body draws attention
choices.reply: M-my body...? Oh. Oh no. Is that why everyone keeps looking?

choices.label: Tell her she looks good even when she's struggling
choices.reply: Y-you think so? Even when I'm making a mess of everything?

openingByFlag.luna_help: You helped me last time without making me feel useless. I'm trying the high shelf again... poorly.
openingByFlag.luna_shirt: You mentioned my shirt before. I tried a different one. It still doesn't behave.
openingByFlag.luna_tease: You teased me last time. Please be nice while I fail at reaching things again.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I tripped on nothing again. You caught me. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You okay?

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Physically yes. Emotionally... I've been thinking about what you said. About people looking.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I always thought I was just clumsy and awkward. I never considered that my body might be... noticeable.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Is it bad that I still don't really know how to feel about it?

choices.label: Tell her she’s still the same kind person
choices.reply: That helps. A lot. I was worried everything would feel different.

choices.label: Say it’s okay to take time figuring it out
choices.reply: You’re patient with me. Most people just stare or laugh.

choices.label: Admit you’ve noticed, but you like her for more than that
choices.reply: You... noticed? And you still talk to me like this? That’s really nice.

openingByFlag.luna_cover: You always cover for me. Even when I make it hard.
openingByFlag.luna_realize: I’ve been thinking about what you said in the shop. About why people look.
openingByFlag.luna_compliment: You said I looked good even when I was struggling. I’ve been replaying that a lot.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I ordered without spilling anything today. Personal record.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Proud of you.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I still don’t really understand why my body gets so much attention. But I’m trying not to let it scare me.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: How’s that going?

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Better when you’re around. You never made me feel like I was just... that. You always treated me like Luna.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: If I trip again, will you still catch me?

choices.label: Promise you’ll always catch her
choices.reply: Then I’ll try not to be too scared of falling.

choices.label: Tell her you like every part of her, clumsy included
choices.reply: Even the clumsy parts...? You’re really something.

choices.label: Say you’ll be there while she figures herself out
choices.reply: That’s all I need. Someone patient. Someone who stays.

openingByFlag.luna_same: You said I was still the same person. I’ve been holding onto that.
openingByFlag.luna_time: You told me it was okay to take time. I think I’m ready to talk about it more.
openingByFlag.luna_notice: You admitted you noticed. And you still wanted to keep talking to me.
